Risk Statement: Unauthorized individuals may gain access to customer financial records after the CRM is migrated to the cloud
Vulnerability Exploited: Weak Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls

Risk Statement: Customer data could be exposed while it is being transferred to the cloud environment
Vulnerability Exploited: Data is not encrypted during migration

Risk Statement: Sensitive information such as customer PII may become publicly accessible because of cloud misconfiguration
Employees may accidentally delete or modify important customer records during migration
Vulnerability Exploited: Poor backup and change management procedures

Risk Statement: A ransomware attack could interrupt the migration process and make customer data unavailable
Vulnerability Exploited: Unpatched systems and weak endpoint security

Risk Statement: The organization may fail to meet NDPA requirements during the migration
Employees with excessive privileges could misuse or access customer information unnecessarily
Vulnerability Exploited: Lack of least privilege and periodic access reviews

Risk Statement: The cloud provider could experience downtime affecting access to the CRM system
Vulnerability Exploited: Limited redundancy and disaster recovery planning

Risk Statement: Weak security controls at the cloud provider may expose customer information through a third-party breach
A data breach could reduce customer confidence and negatively affect the company's reputation
